html:
An animation by design_cells on how we hear, shared on Ziyu Acoustics with a short note: the human body is surely the most finely engineered instrument in the world.

Fanyu Meng points readers to a related piece from the account’s early days, published on 2019-08-24: How do we perceive pitch? He also marvels that the account has somehow been running for almost four years: it is nearly old enough to graduate from university.

Video: design_cells, shared by Fanyu Meng on Ziyu Acoustics.
